## What changed?

Describe the Recipe, tooling, documentation, or site change.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] Every changed Recipe has an incremented `Alert-Build`.
- [ ] New or promoted Recipes were observed on the runtime recorded in their header.
- [ ] Credits and origin links remain attached.
- [ ] Reusable YAML contains no Discord IDs, player IP output, tokens, webhooks, or private server data.
- [ ] Only the intended Recipe is changed; generated artifacts were not hand-edited.
